input_policy: Use this frozen source only; never substitute live formal source.
product_helper_requirement: Keep the final main/helper pair together in native/wsl_release. These drivers do not export PDF; child product --history uses the ordinary report-capable shell.

common.gui_execution: One coordinated serial GUI slot; build script never launches GUI.
common.runtime_libraries: Use target_wrapper.sh for system x86_64 Qt libraries/plugins.

integrated_shell_test.process_rule: Each method must run in a separate OS process. write/read share the same new evidence root. Do not invoke the entire suite without method arguments.
xcb_dependencies: DISPLAY with the coordinated WSLg session
integrated_shell_test.xcb_exit_scope: 12-second idle then PID-verified WM_DELETE_WINDOW, functional exit only; no performance claim.
integrated_shell_test.skipped_this_round: measureExperiment (60 seconds); separate 30-second seven-store instrument baseline is planned.
integrated_shell_test.fixtures: Anonymous account secret generated only at runtime; history fixture embedded in the production QRC. No external fixture argument.
integrated_shell_test.sensitive_runtime: Keep all runtime databases, tags and transient secret files under temp. Do not archive account database fields.
integrated_shell_test.viewport_scope: Requires real screen geometry, mapped/active native windows and QApplication.widgetAt hit testing. Offscreen is not applicable; preserve its failed invocation as an environment-boundary observation.

status_replay_shell_test.process_rule: One full-suite process for each QPA. Each evidence root must be absolute and must not exist before initTestCase.
status_replay_shell_test.input_failure_child: Relative replay path must exit 2 without creating its requested data root.

qt_test_output: Add -o <absolute log>.txt,txt -o <absolute log>.xml,xml to every invocation.
